notes: maintables.do line 59: reghdfe fatal major, absorb(modelyr mmid) vce(cluster make). Repeated cross-section of crash occupants (accident years 1991-2007) assigned to vehicle model (mmid) x model year (modelyr, 1975-2003) cells; calendar time = model year; several occupants per cell. Prepared data = maindata.dta restricted to the 29,838-row reghdfe sample (79 singleton observations dropped iteratively on mmid and modelyr) with g_modelyr = post94 (model year of the model's first post-1994 major redesign; 0 if never redesigned or redesigned after 2003). Verified major == 1[modelyr >= g_modelyr > 0] on every row; no switch-offs. gvar used so always-treated models (83 models, 2,394 obs, observed only at modelyr >= post94) keep their true cohort. Cohorts 1995-2003 (9), 165 models with pre-period observations, 216 never-treated models. fixest feols(fatal ~ major | modelyr + mmid, cluster = ~make) reproduces reghdfe exactly: -0.01651235 (0.004357979), N 29,838, 47 clusters. Author's preferred column is probably Column 4 (full covariates, ineligible); Column 1 is the no-controls baseline. No article text in the project, so in_abstract_intro could not be verified. CSA in run_spec.R fails because did::att_gt requires unique (id, t): repeated-cross-section CSA (panel = FALSE) computed separately, see data/replication_logs/mnsc.2023.01987.md.
